metadata.description: Younger brother of Elwë (Thingol). One of the two kings of the Teleri, ruling the Teleri of Valinor from Alqualondë. As king of Alqualondë, he welcomed the Noldor arriving from Middle-earth, though conflict later arose. Father of Eärwen, who married Finarfin of the Noldor, making him grandfather to Finrod, Angrod, Aegnor, and Galadriel. Remained in Valinor while his brother ruled in Beleriand.
